item.title: Remove dead product-owner.md and tech-lead.md agent files and orchestrator code paths
item.intent: Dead agent files and unreachable code paths must be removed — they cause false positives in reviews and drift further from reality over time.
item.description: d3571ad merged tech-lead+product-owner into groomer.md but left both files on disk. build_agent_prompt() still has dead branches for product-owner and tech-lead at lines 1607, 1684, 1691, 1785, 1799.
steps: Remove product-owner and tech-lead branches from build_agent_prompt()
Remove from permissions and max-turns case statements

acceptanceCriteria.text: product-owner.md and tech-lead.md do not exist
Orchestrator does not reference product-owner or tech-lead
